description: List the people who share this account: the owner, each teammate and each pending invitation the owner made or confirmed, with the seats the plan includes. An invitation that an API key or connected app asked for appears on this list only after the account owner confirms it; until then, list_pending_access shows it. Only the account owner's API keys and connected apps can list the team, while the plan includes team seats. Reading changes nothing.
name: list_team_members

alerts.description: For a teammate: whether they still receive the team's transfer alerts. Null for a pending invitation.

id.description: The seat id, used to resend an invitation or remove the teammate.

invitation_delivery.description: For a pending invitation: sent when it is queued for delivery; pending or unverified when delivery is not confirmed, and resend_team_invitation can try again. Null for a teammate.

status.description: invited: the invitation is not accepted yet. active: a teammate.

seats.description: Seats the plan includes and seats in use, the owner and pending invitations included.

title: List the team
